items.title: Graduate Silicon Architect 2027
items.snippet: <p><strong>Location:</strong> Bristol, UK<br><strong>Salary:</strong> £45,000 per annum <br><strong>Start date: </strong>September 2027<br><strong>Application deadline</strong>: Midnight, 29th November 2026 <br><em>We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline.</em></p> <h3>The Graduate Programme at Graphcore</h3> <p>Join Graphcore in a permanent role and start your career with two years of hands-on learning. From day one, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, share your ideas and help shape what we’re creating. You’ll tackle challenging problems alongside a team who support your development and are as excited about your success as you are.</p> <p><iframe style="display: table; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/sUqy-WuXPsE" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <h3><span data-contrast="none">What you’ll work on</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">Put your understanding of computer architecture to work on the choices that shape Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">As a Graduate Silicon Architect, you’ll help specify, model and evaluate complex system-on-chip (SoC) subsystems, with guidance from experienced architects. You’ll explore how product requirements translate into technical options, design trade-offs and validation plans.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Your work will likely include some of: taking responsibility for the architecture of a chip subsystem or function, modelling architectural features, assessing third-party intellectual property (IP) and supporting silicon bring-up. Working across design, verification, hardware and software teams, you’ll help gather the performance evidence that supports architecture decisions.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <h3><span data-contrast="none">Your team and support</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">The Silicon Architecture team sits within the Silicon group. We stand for practical ambition: clear thinking, careful engineering and curiosity that improves real systems.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">You’ll work with mentors and experienced architects through design reviews, modelling, simulation, documentation and discussions with neighbouring teams. You’ll take ownership of defined tasks that grow in scope as you develop your skills.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Simulations, performance data and design constraints help guide our decisions. You’ll be encouraged to ask questions, challenge existing approaches and share ideas for making things better. Take responsibility for your work and speak up when something needs testing, explaining or support.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <h3><span data-contrast="none">How you’ll learn and grow</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">During the two-year programme, you’ll develop your architecture skills through hands-on architectural design + integration, modelling and evaluation of AI acceleration hardware, supported by mentors.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Exploring technical options and running simulations will help you understand how architecture choices affect system behaviour. You’ll learn how to compare trade-offs, document findings and use performance evidence to support a decision.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Design reviews and work across engineering teams will help you connect specifications to implementation and validation. Supporting silicon bring-up will give you experience of how architectural ideas are checked on real hardware, while tasks that grow in scope will build your technical judgement and confidence.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <h3><span data-contrast="none">What we’re looking for</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></h3> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="none">A degree, or expected degree, in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science or a related field</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">An understanding of computer architecture or digital systems, </span><span data-contrast="none">with an interest in SoC design, AI hardware or high-performance computing</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Programming experience in Python, Rust, C++ or a similar language</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Analytical problem-solving skills and clear written and verbal communication, including documenting findings and explaining technical ideas</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="none">You can demonstrate these skills through coursework, a dissertation, personal or team projects, research, or other relevant experience. Tell us what you built or investigated, how you approached it and what you learned.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559685":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Exposure to register-transfer level (RTL) design, modelling, simulation, PCIe, Ethernet or DDR would be useful. These are additional strengths, rather than essential requirements.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559685":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility</li> <li>Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension</li> <li>Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success</li> <li>Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day</li> <li>Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones</li> <li>Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice</li> <li>Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover</li> <li>Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br><br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <h3>Sponsorship</h3> <p>Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme, without requiring visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor work visas for our Early Careers opportunities.</p> <h3>Introduction to Graphcore</h3> <p>At Graphcore, we’re building next generation AI compute: from semiconductors and software to systems at datacenter scale. We are proud to be owned by SoftBank Group and work with other companies in the SoftBank family to deliver AI compute to customers working at the AI frontier. Starting your career here means working alongside people with different backgrounds and expertise, from AI researchers to chip designers and software engineers. You’ll learn from each other, bring fresh ideas and help solve challenging problems together.</p> <h3>How to apply and what to expect </h3> <p>To apply, answer the application questions below and upload your CV and cover letter. We’ll let you know the outcome of your application by early December at the latest. If successful, you’ll be invited to complete a technical assessment. Candidates who reach the final stage will then be invited to attend in-person assessments in early spring.</p> <p><em><strong><span class="TextRun SCXW131428339 BCX0" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW131428339 BCX0">Ready to put your learning into practice? Start your career in a permanent SoC Architecture Engineer role, with two years of hands-on learning through the Graphcore Graduate Programme. </span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW131428339 BCX0" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW131428339 BCX0">Apply now and help shape what comes next.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW131428339 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></strong></em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.</span><br><br></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">WHY JOIN US</span></strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.</span></li> </ul></div><p><strong>ABOUT THE TEAM</strong></p> <p>You will join our central Talent Acquisition team operating across our hubs in Europe. We are a fast-moving, collaborative team dedicated to scaling Stark Defence by bringing elite talent into our engineering, software, and operational functions. In this role, you will work closely with TA Partners during a critical phase of recruitment system modernization and process optimization.</p> <p><strong>YOUR MISSION</strong></p> <p>As a Working Student in Recruitment Support, you will play a key role in driving our recruitment tools migration and system optimization. You will ensure seamless data accuracy, support initial candidate application workflows, and help maintain precise talent documentation across our recruitment platforms.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the migration of active and archived recruitment data between ATSs.</li> <li>Review incoming job applications and classify candidate profiles according to standardized talent tags and role criteria.</li> <li>Maintain accurate candidate records, compliance documentation, and talent pipeline tags in line with GDPR standards.</li> <li>Assist TA Partners with auditing job descriptions, maintaining high quality standards across platforms</li> <li>Collaborate with Talent Acquisition Partners to ensure swift data processing and resolve minor ATS workflow bottlenecks.</li> <li>Coordinate and initiate background and security verification checks for candidates in line with defence industry requirements</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION</strong></p> <ul> <li>Enrolled student in Business Administration, Human Resources, Psychology, Business Informatics, or a related field in Germany.</li> <li>High attention to detail and strong organizational skills for handling large volumes of recruitment data accurately.</li> <li>Fluency in English (written and spoken); German proficiency is a strong advantage.</li> <li>Available to work up to 20 hours per week on-site or hybrid in Berlin or Munich.</li> <li>Strong digital affinity and comfort working with modern SaaS tools and spreadsheets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>NICE TO HAVE</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior exposure to Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) such as Greenhouse, or similar CRM databases.</li> <li>Basic understanding of GDPR compliance and data protection guidelines in recruitment.</li> <li>Previous experience in an administrative or talent acquisition support role in a fast-paced environment.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your <strong>CV in English</strong>. We're looking forward to meeting you!</span></span></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>SECURITY CLEARANCE</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.</span></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>EQUAL OPPORTUNITY</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</span></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>DATA PRIVACY STATEMENT</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This data privacy statement, which refers exclusively to data collected as part of the online application process, is to inform you about how your personal data that is collected as part of the online application process is handled at our end.</span></p> <p><strong>The controller</strong></p> <p>The controller under data protection law is:</p> <p>SKD SE</p> <p><strong>Französische Strasse 12, 10117 Berlin</strong></p> <p>Commercial register entry number: <strong>HRB 260878</strong></p> <p>Registration Court: Amtsgericht Charlottenburg</p> <p><strong>Data Protection officer:</strong> heyData GmbH, Schützenstraße 5, 10117 Berlin,<a href="http://www.heydata.eu"> www.heydata.eu</a>, ----- <p><em><strong>Personal data collected as part of the application process</strong></em></p> <p>Personal data means any information concerning the personal or material circumstances of an identified or identifiable individual. This includes information such as, for example, your name, address, telephone number and date of birth, but also data relating to your specific career etc. by reference to which a specific individual can be identified with reasonable effort. However, information which cannot be (in)directly associated with your real-life identity is not personal data.</p> <p>Fundamentals and purposes of processing personal data collected from application documents and during the application process</p> <p>If you apply to us electronically, i.e. via e-mail or using our online form, we will collect and process your personal data for the purpose of executing the application process and preparing contracts.</p> <p>By submitting an application via our recruitment website, you express your interest in taking up work with us. In this context, you transmit personal data, which we will use and store exclusively for the purpose of your job search / application process.</p> <p>In particular, the following data is collected during this process:</p> <ul> <li>name (first and last names)</li> <li>e-mail address</li> <li>phone number</li> <li>LinkedIn profile (optional)</li> <li>channel through which you found us</li> </ul> <p>Furthermore, you can choose to upload expressive documents such as a cover letter, your CV and reference letters. These may contain additional personal data such as date of birth, address etc.</p> <p>Only authorized HR staff and/or staff involved in the application process have access to your data.</p> <p>The personal data is stored, as a rule, exclusively for the purpose of filling the vacancy for which you have applied.</p> <p>Your data will be stored for a period of 180 days after the application process has been concluded. This is usually done to fulfill legal requirements and/or defending ourselves against any claims arising from legal provisions. After this period, we are obligated to delete or anonymize your data. In case of anonymization, the data will only be available to us in the form of so-called metadata, without any direct personal reference, for statistical analysis (for example, share of male and/or female applicants, number of applications per specified period of time etc.).</p> <p>Furthermore, we reserve the right to store your data for 180 days after the application process has been concluded for the purpose of adding it to our Talent Pool in order to identify any other vacancies that may be of interest to you. This includes, for example, applications for apprenticeships or internships. By accepting the data privacy statement, you consent to any further storage of your data as well as its inclusion in our Talent Pool.</p> <p>Should you be offered and accept a position with us during the application process, we will store the personal data collected as part of the application process for at least the duration of your employment.</p> <p><strong>Disclosure of data to third parties</strong></p> <p>Data transmitted as part of your application will be transferred using TLS encryption and stored in a database. This database is operated by Greenhouse, which offers a human resource and applicant management software solution (https://www.greenhouse.com/data-processing-addendum). In this context, Greenhouse is our processor under article 28 of the GDPR. In this case, the processing is based on an agreement for the processing of orders between us as the controller and Greenhouse.</p> <p><strong>Rights of data subjects</strong></p> <p>If we as the controller process personal data, you as the data subject have certain rights under Chapter III of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), depending on the legal basis and the purpose of the processing, in particular the right of access (article 15 of the GDPR) and the rights to rectification (article 16 of the GDPR), erasure (article 17 of the GDPR), restriction of processing (article 18 of the GDPR), and data portability (article 20 of the GDPR), as well as the right to object (article 21 of the GDPR). If the personal data is processed with your consent, you have the right to withdraw this consent under article 7 III of the GDPR.</p> <p>To assert your rights as a data subject in relation to the data processed during this online application process, please refer to our Data Protection Officer (see item 2).</p> <p><strong>Concluding provisions</strong></p> <p>We reserve the right to adjust this data privacy statement at any point in time to ensure that it is in line with the current legal requirements at all times, or in order to accommodate changes in the application process or other processes. In this case, the new data privacy statement applies to any later visit of this recruitment website or any later job application.<br><br></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>LEGAL NOTICE</strong></span></p> <h3>1. Information according to § 5 DDG</h3> <p>SKD SE<br>Französische Str. 12<br>10117 Berlin</p> <p><br>Internet: <a href="https://stark-defence.com/en/">www.stark-defence.com<br></a>E-Mail: ----- <p>SKD SE, Berlin (registered office of the company), is a Societas Europaea (legal form for joint stock companies), registered at the district court of Berlin (Charlottenburg) under the register number: HRB 260878 B, represented by the Executive Board: Uwe Horstmann, Dr. André Schneider, Johannes Schaback, Jan-Patrick Helmsen, Martin Rost.</p> <p>Chairman of the Supervisory Board is Mr. Robert Maier.</p> <p>VAT ID No.: DE369778559</p> <h3>2. items.snippet: 🌐 We are on the mission to build Europe’s leading energy management platform to provide fair, clean energy to everyone. ⚡ We’re a diverse team of 50+ employees , with 46% being female and from 16+ nationalities , and steadily growing. Having raised of over €40 M in total, we are looking for passionate people to join us on our mission! 🚀 🇩🇪 Wir haben eine klare Mission: Wir bauen Europas führende Plattform für Energiemanagement, um faire und saubere Energie für alle zugänglich zu machen. ⚡ Unser Team ist vielfältig – wir sind über 50 Personen aus mehr als 16 Nationalitäten , mit einem Frauenanteil von 46 % . Und wir wachsen weiter! Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and projects simultaneously An analytical mindset and confidence working with data, reporting, and operational processes A proactive, hands-on attitude with a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to take initiative A proactive mindset towards using AI and automation to improve efficiency, while being mindful of potential risks and limitations Must-have: Fluent German (C2, ideally native-level) and excellent written and spoken English (C1/C2) 🌐 About Us We’re Germany’s fastest-growing digital green energy provider and a Certified B Corp™ , driving the energy transition by making renewable energy more accessible and inclusive. Try things out, learn along the way, and keep moving forward. 🇩🇪 Über Uns Wir sind der am schnellsten wachsende digitale Ökostromanbieter mit B Corp™ Zertifizierung in Deutschland – und treiben die Energiewende aktiv voran. Unser Ziel: Erneuerbare Energie für alle zugänglich und inklusiv machen. Wie? Mit variablen Tarifen, dynamischem Strompreis, Smart EV Charging, Optimierung von Wärmepumpen und Solaranlagen sowie Deutschlands erstem virtuellen Kraftwerk: NeoGrid™. Bei Ostrom arbeitest du in einem offenen, dynamischen Umfeld, in dem du du selbst sein kannst, Herausforderungen annimmst und dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelst. 🌱 Nachhaltigkeit, die zählt: Mit deinem Wechsel zu Ostrom unterstützt du aktiv die Energiewende. Unsere Kund*innen helfen im Schnitt, jährlich 1,5 Tonnen CO₂ gegenüber dem deutschen Durchschnittsstrommix einzusparen. 📈 Wertschätzung, die sich auszahlt: Neben einem attraktiven Gehalt erhältst du bei uns VSOPs – Unternehmensanteile, mit denen du direkt am Erfolg von Ostrom beteiligt bist. 👭 Teamkultur auf Augenhöhe: Bei Ostrom leben wir flache Hierarchien und eine offene Feedbackkultur. Deine Meinung zählt – vom ersten Tag an. 💪🏽 Benefits: Du erhältst ein flexibles Paket mit vielen Extras – von einem jährlichen Weiterbildungsbudget, über eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, bis hin zu einer vergünstigten USC-Mitgliedschaft, einem vergünstigten BVG Jobticket oder deinem eigenen E-Bike bzw. E-Roller und sowie Rabattcodes über FutureBens. items.title: Social Media Intern
items.snippet: Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success. Today, we serve over 5 million clients, with more than €30 billion in assets under management - a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years. We are looking for a Social Media Marketing Intern to support the growth and day-to-day management of our German-language social media presence. The role is suited to a native German speaker with strong social media taste, an understanding of current platform trends, and practical experience managing corporate social media accounts. The person will help to create platform-native content, draft and schedule posts, support short-form video production, and coordinate Legal and Compliance review by preparing and submitting content approval tickets. What you'll do Manage and grow Trading 212's German-language social media accounts. Drive growth through creation of social media posts, captions, short-form videos. Analyze social media trends and competitor activity in the fintech space. Engage in video content creation for Instagram and TikTok. Improve account performance, engagement, audience growth, and content learnings. Contribute ideas for organic growth campaigns and community engagement. What you need to have Native German speaker with excellent communication skills. Strong interest in social media, content trends, creator formats, and storytelling. Previous experience in managing (corporate) social media accounts. Good understanding of Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and short-form video formats. Ability to write posts with the right tone for a regulated financial brand. Strong attention to detail. Ability to manage deadlines, review cycles, and multiple content pieces at once. It’s a Bonus If You Have Experience scaling an Instagram account. Experience creating or supporting "talking head" content for Instagram and TikTok. Experience using social media scheduling, analytics, or project management tools. What we offer A unique opportunity to be part of the team that builds our presence in Germany from the ground up. Challenging projects with high impact on our international growth. Collaboration with a team of smart, driven, and supportive high-performers. A flexible, idea-friendly culture that values ownership and initiative. Competitive Remuneration package. Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker! We thank all applicants, but only candidates selected for interview will be contacted. All personal data of applicants is protected by law and treated with strict confidentiality. items.title: General Secretary Associate intern
items.snippet: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐ General Secretary Associate Internship ⭐ The position is open for gap year or end-of-study interns with a starting date in March 2027, for a six-month internship. It is not open to MBA students. The Associate supports the General Secretary on top business priorities, such as building new processes internally and externally. This role offers a unique opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects in a dynamic and innovative environment. ⭐ Detailed missions ⭐ The list below is not exhaustive as it will depend on the company priorities during your internship. However it gives a good overview of the range of topics and tasks. Regular missions and recent projects Sales & Business - Prepare meetings with external stakeholders, support in following up post meetings, track actions to conversion and maintain stakeholder momentum. 👉Help in the organization of events with investors and customers. Corporate & Governance - Support research and projects related to regulatory stakeholders, fundraisings and governance matters. 👉 Contribution to board pack preparation and management (content, timelines, Q&A); conduct targeted legal and market research. Internal missions - Work on highly structural topics (salary grids, internal frameworks). Improve internal processes and cross-team coordination to ensure Alan can scale without compromising its core values. 👉 Harmonization of the weekly internal communication Brand & Communication - Strengthen the HR & Corporate presence at major events and on social channels, organise internal and external events to build the Alan network and systematize outreach and leverage connections globally. 👉End-to-end organization of events with top schools in our offices Product & Technical topics - Support cross-functional projects through research, synthesis, and stakeholder coordination, turn insights into actionable recommendations for product and operations. Talent - Sourcing and recruiting the next GS Associate. 👉Development of the hiring process for the next GS Associate ⭐ Profile & Competencies ⭐ Skills Proactive & curious - You will be expected to deliver quickly and well on the tasks assigned to you, while to also always be going the extra-mile and show proactive thinking. Analytical judgment and critical thinking - GS Associate produces a lot of research and analysis. This requires the ability to frame the right questions, evaluate and problem-solve including possible outcomes. Versatility and stellar execution - You are comfortable with context switching while maintaining impact. Organization and autonomy - You are well-served in missions requiring precision and reliability. Crisp thinking and clear communication - You communicate effectively and concisely . Step back - You have the ability to take a step back and understand the business needs related to any mission. Technical appetite - Having an aptitude in or appetite for automation, AI and/or data analysis is a plus. Languages Fluency in spoken and written English. Fluency in spoken and written French. Background We welcome applications from (at least M1 graduated) candidates with diverse educational backgrounds, including but not limited to: Business schools (HEC, ESSEC, ESCP, LSE …) Engineering schools (Polytechnique, Mines Paris, Ecole des Ponts, CentraleSupelec, Imperial … ) Law schools or political sciences/communication/HR masters in various schools (Science Po, Assas, La Sorbonne, Dauphine…) Data science or mathematics programs Other relevant fields or schools (Bocconi, Politecnico, TU Delft, UCL, Oxford, Cambridge) Diplomas matter to an extent but if you don’t have one and have built a project or a company, we’d love to hear from you so please send your application! 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish. Transport. Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . Important note: we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application! 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. #LI-DNP Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

items.title: AI Engineer l Young Talent Program
items.snippet: The rules of building are being rewritten. Come write them with us. Every few decades, the way companies are built gets reinvented from scratch. That is happening right now, and the people who learn to build in this new world first will define the next twenty years. Superstars are being made this year, not in ten. HelloPrint is a €100M+ e-commerce company serving businesses across Europe and the US. We are rebuilding the entire company as AI-first: our platform, customer service, operations, and how we design, price, sell, and deliver. Every piece of technology we run is being rewritten as we speak. We are doing it with a small, senior, very fast AI development team working shoulder to shoulder with our business leads. Now we are opening a handful of seats for young builders who want to grow faster than any graduate scheme, bootcamp, or big-tech ladder could ever let them. We don't care if you are 16, 25 or 30, whether you are self-taught, hacking in high school, or finishing a degree at TU Delft or TU/e—we care about what you have built and how fast you solve hard problems. The HelloPrint AI Residency is how you start. It is a permanent role from day one: your first year is a structured residency where you rotate across our most important AI projects, build alongside the team and learn at full speed. After that, you keep growing - in the direction where you have the most impact. What you will actually do: You will not get a training plan, a sandbox project or six months of shadowing. From week one, you build real things that real customers and colleagues use, on the projects that matter most to the company. You sit next to the founders, next to the engineers who are rebuilding our platform, and next to the business leads who own the outcomes. You get a lot of freedom and real responsibility, plus honest, direct guidance and feedback from people who have built this before. The kind of work you could be on in your first months: Agentic Commerce : making HelloPrint discoverable and orderable through AI assistants, so a customer can order business cards from inside a chat. AI Design Studio : letting customers create a print-ready design from a single sentence. AI-first customer service : replacing classic ticketing with agents that resolve questions, check artwork and handle orders end to end. Internal agent swarms : automating finance, purchasing, pricing and operations work that today still takes people hours. Whatever you spot next : if you see something we should build, you pitch it, and if it is good, you build it. We work with almost every modern framework and model, and we change our tools the moment something better appears. You will ship, measure, throw away and ship again - every week. Who you are: You are a builder before anything else . You have shipped things nobody asked you to build: an app, an agent, a bot, a tool your friends actually use, a side business, an open-source contribution, a weird experiment that taught you something. You probably have more GitHub commits, demos or deployed projects than most people twice your age. You are extremely curious and extremely critical. You read the new model release the day it drops and try it that evening. You question every assumption, including ours, and you can explain why. You are never satisfied with "it works" — you want to know why it works, and how it could be ten times better. You want to get better every single day, and you treat feedback as fuel rather than criticism. You take ownership: when something breaks, you fix it; when something is unclear, you go and find out. You have a solid grasp of backend and software fundamentals (Python, APIs, databases) or the raw learning capacity to pick them up in weeks. You will probably recognise yourself in most of this: You build with AI every day: Claude, Cursor, Lovable, agents, APIs, whatever gets you there fastest. You can show us concrete proof of work, not just tell us about it. You move fast without being sloppy, and you care about the details the customer sees. You are comfortable not knowing the answer, and you find it quickly. You communicate clearly in English, in writing and out loud. What we do not require: a degree, a minimum age, years of experience or a perfect CV. If you are still in school or university, we will make it work around that. What you get: The honest pitch: you will learn more here in one year than in five years almost anywhere else , because you will be building real systems for a real company that is reinventing itself, with the people who are leading that change. A contract from day one. The Residency is your first year at HelloPrint, not a trial period or an internship. Direct access to the founders and to a senior AI development team who review your work and push you. Ownership from day one : your name on projects that change how a €100M+ company runs. The best tools, no budget debates : the newest models, coding agents and frameworks, as soon as they are worth using. A growth path that follows your output, not your age : if you outgrow your role in six months, your role grows with you. A fast, flat, no-politics team in Rotterdam, with a hands-on culture and a high bar. Flexible set-up : full-time, or part-time alongside your studies. We care about what you deliver. Salary and contract are tailored to your situation and your level, and we pay properly for real talent. How to apply: Skip the cover letter. Show us what you have built. Send us three things: Your best project : a link to something you built: a live product, a repo, a demo video. Tell us in a few sentences what it does and what you would do differently now. Something you think is broken : one thing about HelloPrint (our website, our ordering flow, anything) that you would rebuild with AI, and how you would do it. A short intro : who you are and what you are obsessed with right now. Five sentences is plenty. What happens next: We read every application ourselves and reply within 5 days if you’re up to the next round A 15-minute call with one of our builders or founders about your projects. A Builders Day in our office: Together with other builders, you meet the team and if we have a click, you work on an assignment A conversation with the founders, and a decision the same day. We would rather hear from you too early than too late. If you are not sure you are ready, apply anyway; your work will answer that question for us. At HelloPrint, we believe diversity makes us better. We're building a workplace where everyone can be themselves, grow, and do their best work regardless of background, identity, or perspective. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

items.snippet: We are investigating real-time edge computing architectures to enhance visual feedback in next-generation medical robotics. items.snippet: Location : 100% remote (Ohio residency required) Classification : Full-time, exempt Reports to : School Leader Pay Range : $40.00 - $48.00 per hour Welcome to Miaplaza! Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð Role Summary The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Instructional Staff Management Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting. Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers. Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback. Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback. Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals. Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences. Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations. Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed. Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes. Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law. Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together. Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns. Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track. Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas. Academic Data & Testing Coordination Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions. Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing. Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families. Professional Development Design and lead regular PD sessions for instructional staff, informed by teacher feedback, observation, and student data. Build a culture of continuous improvement, reflective practice, and growth for the instructional team. Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities. Curriculum & Cross-Team Collaboration Serve as the primary point of contact between the instructional team and the Content team on curriculum, checkpoint assignments, and MiaPrep platform issues. Gather teacher and student feedback and make curriculum recommendations. Support consistency in instructional practice and expectations across courses and departments. Lead regular instructional team meetings to align resources, expectations, and practices. Assist teachers in comparing their curriculum to the OST blueprints to identify gaps, and create a plan to fill these gaps in the short and long term.Â What We're Looking For Proven leadership experience managing, coaching, or mentoring teachers Sound judgment and a steady hand with sensitive student, family, and staff situations; knows when to resolve and when to escalate A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation that holds up to scrutiny A fair, consistent, relationship-first approach to discipline and accountability Comfort with data and the ability to translate it into clear decisions Exceptional organization and follow-through across many concurrent priorities Resilient, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment Growth mindset with a focus on coaching and constructive feedback THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY DECEMBER 1ST, 2026.
